# Camp Buff Item: Poseidon Arm Wrestle Machine

- Duchess Flame![Writer: Duchess Flame]()
- Jun 1, 2025
- 2 min read

![](https://static.wixstatic.com/media/586626_f16c60d4f7ce435db76e75bf05c2b387~mv2.jpg)

Image Credit:

The buffs you receive from these camp items will stack with buffs from food, chems, drinks, armor, and other sources.

However, you cannot stack multiple camp items that provide the same buff—for example, two items that both grant Luck or Intelligence will not stack. Additionally, camp item buffs do not stack with themselves.

Mortal, dare you face the might of the God of the Sea?

- Using the Arm Wrestle Machine will grant a temporary stat Boost -

- C.A.M.P. ITEMS APPEAR WHILE IN C.A.M.P. MODE. -

__Poseidon Arm Wrestle Machine__

![](https://static.wixstatic.com/media/586626_407275ec786c4a13997c724b1684ba00~mv2.jpg)

**Buff:**

+2 Charisma

Does not stack with other Charisma Camp Buff items.

**Lasts for:**

30 minutes

**Player animation:**

Yes

**Build limit per camp**

1 per camp

**Build limit per workshop**

1 per workshop

**Shares a build limit with**

3 per camp, shelter, or workshop

Shares a build limit with the Arm Wrestle Machine, Vault Girl Arm Wrestle Machine, Mechanical Derby Game, and Atlantic City Mechanical Derby Game

**Found under X in the camp build menu**

Misc Structures

**Materials required to craft resource**

1x Circuitry

1x Copper

2x Rubber

2x Steel

**Holds**

N/A

**Obtainable via**

Season 21 - Gone Fission - Page 6 - 50 Tickets

Gold Bullion - X - Cautious - X Bullion

**Produces X amount per**

N/A

**Lockable**

N/A

**Power Required**

No

**Flamingo Units**

1 Flamingo Unit
